profile.performanceReview: Be Still, My Soul。已逐段核对完整英文转写，实际演唱原文第1、2、4段，原文第3段未唱，页面仍保留全部原文坐标。全部13个演唱片段均对应现有正文，末尾Thank you为致谢，不作为歌词。每个实际阅读区域仍须正文至少60%逐字对应及原有双窗口起点、词尾与实际演唱顺序检查。

segments.text: Be still, my soul, the Lord is on your side. Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain.
Leave to your God, to order and provide, In every change, be faithful, we'll remain.
Be still, my soul, your best, your heavenly friend
Through thorny ways leads to a joyful end
Be still, my soul, your God will undertake
To guide the future as he has the past.
Your hope, your confidence, let nothing shake.
All now mysterious shall be bright at last.
Be still, my soul, the waves, the winds, still no ho. His voice throughrode them while he dwelt below.
Be still, my soul, the hour is hastening on, When we shall be forever with the Lord.
When disappointment, grief, and fear are gone, Sorrow forgot, love's purest joys restored.
Be still, my soul, when change and tears are passed.
All safe and blessed, we shall meet at last.
